li.label: room for dinner
li.description: The big chair has room for my dinner. No floor food, and I can reach it!

li.label: the big chair serves dinner again
li.description: Dinner here again! Big chair, full tummy.

li.label: sit still, dinner!
li.description: This chair seats people and dinner. Stay there, dinner. Here I come!

li.label: a borrowed dinner stand
li.description: Other people sit on chairs. I put dinner on mine. Small paws, plenty of ideas.

li.label: my chair-sized diner
li.description: This chair again. Today's diner only serves guests my size.

li.label: usual spot, my dinner
li.description: This chair makes a handy food stand. Anyone wanting a seat can wait until I finish this bite.

li.label: borrowing a chair again
li.description: Dinner on the seat. It works, but it hardly looks like a proper meal.

li.label: dinner sits, I stand
li.description: A chair again. Dinner gets a seat. This Ratkin does not.

li.label: no pictures of this meal
li.description: How many times now? People think I am having dinner. Really, I am serving a chair.

li.label: one makeshift meal
li.description: Borrow a chair for dinner, then let it get back to being a chair. One makeshift meal will do.

li.label: the temporary fix gets renewed
li.description: Dinner on a chair again. This temporary arrangement gets renewed surprisingly often.

li.label: paying dinner rent to a chair
li.description: Meal after meal on this seat. The chair is becoming my permanent dinner address.

li.label: little chair, dinner time!
li.description: Dinner is close enough for my paws. Little chair, dinner time!

li.label: dinner is so close
li.description: Dinner by the little chair again. Reach out a paw and there is something tasty.

li.label: my little chair!
li.description: My little chair! Dinner goes here. Please, please do not move it!

li.label: little chair, big ideas
li.description: A Ratkin chair holds dinner at just the right height. Small furniture for small diners. Handy!

li.label: the chair diner is open
li.description: Dinner at my little stand again. No tickets, and no crowding by tall guests.

li.label: this Ratkin has a regular spot
li.description: I know this little chair well. Set down dinner, reach out a paw, and another comfortable meal is ready.

li.label: lower makes it easier
li.description: The little chair is just the right height. At least dinner does not require stretching myself taller.

li.label: Ratkin ingenuity
li.description: Dinner on the little chair again. Do not laugh. This is furniture use tailored to my height.

li.label: this one, leave it here
li.description: My paws know this height now. Other people change furniture; I have found my chair.

li.label: right size, easy meal
li.description: A Ratkin chair holds dinner without tiptoeing or bending. Little furniture has its advantages.

li.label: familiar paws, familiar chair
li.description: Dinner here again. Put it on the seat, and my paws already know where to reach.

li.label: little chair, old dinner friend
li.description: After a few meals, this little chair understands Ratkin better than some tall people do. Keep it here.

li.label: where is my lift?
li.description: Dinner is ready. The chair is over there. I am still over here.

li.label: another dinner on the floor
li.description: Nobody came to lift me... Dinner on the floor again.

li.label: my paws are tired of asking
li.description: Again! I still cannot get up there. Even dinner is getting sleepy waiting.

li.label: not my dinner chair
li.description: They put me on the potty with my dinner. Cold bottom, funny smell... I want a hug.

li.label: potty dinner again
li.description: Dinner here again? I tuck my tail up and hold my food tight. Please take me somewhere else.

li.label: take me off, please
li.description: I reached up for a hug and got another potty dinner. I ate, but I still want to be picked up.

li.label: the wrong kind of bowl
li.description: I know what this is for. Calling it my little dinner table does not make it one.

li.label: the bathroom regular
li.description: Back at the toilet for dinner. I ate quickly and hoped nobody would come in.

li.label: my very own unwanted diner
li.description: Everyone has a usual dinner spot now. Mine has a flush. Please stop laughing.

li.label: do not call it a throne
li.description: Dinner on a toilet. A royal banquet, apparently. My ears are burning, and I am not laughing.

li.label: the joke is still not funny
li.description: Another meal on this seat. I kept my tail clear and my eyes on the door.

li.label: do not tell anyone
li.description: Yes, this is where I eat now. No, you may not give my toilet diner a name.

li.label: dignity served on porcelain
li.description: There is a meal, a toilet, and me trying to pretend those things belong together.

li.label: a reservation nobody wanted
li.description: The toilet again. Apparently my dinner reservation includes plumbing and an audience.

li.label: the house special is resignation
li.description: Meal after meal here. I know where to put my tail now. That is not a skill I wanted.

li.label: a strange dinner perch
li.description: They put me on a strange seat with my food. I curled my tail up. Can we eat somewhere familiar?

li.label: the strange seat again
li.description: This seat again... I hold my dinner close and look for the person who put me here.

li.label: my paws want a hug
li.description: Another dinner up here. My tummy is full, but my paws still reach for someone to take me down.

li.label: this is not a dinner table
li.description: They said any seat would do. This one looks as if it has a very different job.

li.label: borrowed seat, uneasy dinner
li.description: Eating here again. I keep wondering whether somebody is about to need this thing.

li.label: the colony odd-seat diner
li.description: My usual dinner spot is now a seat with another purpose. Nobody asked whether I wanted that.

li.label: please stop watching
li.description: Dinner on this peculiar seat. I can hear the jokes already. Let me finish in peace.

li.label: the seat gets another shift
li.description: Another meal here. This seat has its real job, then an extra shift humiliating me.

li.label: this joke has become furniture
li.description: I have eaten here so often that people point me straight to it. My ears flatten every time.

li.label: a seat doing the wrong job
li.description: A meal on furniture meant for something else. A practical solution, if one ignores my dignity.

li.label: the makeshift spot becomes routine
li.description: Back here for dinner. The arrangement gets less temporary while my objections get quieter.

li.label: assigned to the odd seat
li.description: This is my dinner spot now, apparently. I finish the meal and leave before anyone makes another remark.
